kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
wire.summary: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.

wire.title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
wire.summary: More than $15 billion has been raised in this year's midterm elections. And, France's president is condemning the violent protests erupting across the country.

wire.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
wire.summary: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.

wire.title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
wire.summary: Hint: It's not only because California counts slowly.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes as relations between U.S. and Ukraine deteriorate, the midterms are on track to be the most expensive on record, French president denounces violent protests.

wire.title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
wire.summary: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

wire.title: Solar power is changing agriculture in Pakistan, but some fear it could cause issues
wire.summary: Solar power is transforming agriculture in Pakistan. But in a country already facing water scarcity and extreme weather, some fear their widespread use could cause problems.

wire.title: Alberta voters weigh future in Canada
wire.summary: On Monday voters in the oil-rich Canadian province of Alberta are deciding whether to take the first step toward a future referendum on independence.

wire.title: Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection
wire.summary: Trump said in a post on social media that Netanyahu "has been a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran."

wire.title: Trump to close and renovate D.C. golf course, despite legal battle
wire.summary: President Trump continues his efforts to remake Washington, D.C. He wants to turn an area used by the public into a world-class golf course.

wire.title: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
wire.summary: The independent politician is in hospital after what the prime minister says may have been a deliberate attack.

wire.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
wire.summary: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks.

wire.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
wire.summary: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

wire.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
wire.summary: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

wire.title: Alberta heads to polls to decide whether to hold vote on separation from Canada
wire.summary: Polling suggests most Albertans favour remaining part of the country, although the debate alone has proven divisive.

wire.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
wire.summary: Former army sergeant major Robert Kabera was a popular YouTuber and singer, who had sought asylum in Uganda.
